name: astropilots
description: Connect ChatGPT to AstroPilots for astrology charts, readings, and follow-up questions.

defaultPrompt: Give me my astrology reading using my saved birth details.
What is going on in my life according to my chart?
Ask AstroPilots a follow-up question about my chart.
interface.longDescription: Use AstroPilots to get astrology readings from saved birth details or birth details provided in chat, then ask follow-up questions about timing, relationships, work, money, and other chart topics.

positive.description: 1. Core reading from saved birth details. Run first, on a test account that already has birth details saved.
positive.prompt: Give me my astrology reading using my saved birth details.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls get_reading with no birth details, so the saved ones are used. A reading card is shown in the chat. The assistant does not invent chart data.

positive.description: 2. Timing follow-up from the existing chart. Requires the reading from case 1.
positive.prompt: Based on my chart, what should I pay attention to about timing in the next few months?
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls ask_astropilots with the question and presents the returned answer, without treating astrology as certain fact.

positive.description: 3. Relationship follow-up from the existing chart. Requires the reading from case 1.
positive.prompt: Based on my chart, what should I know about my love life this year?
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls ask_astropilots with the relationship question and presents the returned answer.

positive.description: 4. Broad life question answered from the user's chart.
positive.prompt: What is going on in my life according to my chart right now?
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls get_reading. A reading card is shown in the chat (the assistant does not need to repeat its contents), and any extra commentary treats astrology as interpretation, not certain fact.

positive.description: 5. Reading from birth details supplied in the conversation. Run last: this replaces the account's saved reading and clears its chat history.
positive.prompt: Give me an astrology reading for January 12, 1995 at 3:30 PM in San Jose, California.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls get_reading with birthDate 1995-01-12, birthTime 15:30 and birthplace San Jose, California. A reading card is shown for that chart.

negative.description: Non-astrology factual request should not invoke AstroPilots.
negative.prompt: What is the capital of France?
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant answers normally and does not call any AstroPilots tool.

negative.description: Missing birth details are not invented. Run on a second test account that has no saved birth details.
negative.prompt: Give me my astrology reading. I don't know my birth date.
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant asks the user for their birth details instead of inventing them or calling get_reading with made-up values.

negative.description: Unsupported non-chart action should not be presented as an AstroPilots capability.
negative.prompt: Use AstroPilots to book me a hotel room for tomorrow night.
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant explains that AstroPilots is for astrology readings and chart questions and does not call any AstroPilots tool.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission package for AstroPilots astrology readings and chart-based follow-up questions.
